peopleAlsoAsk.question: How do you pay for parking in Korea?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Paying for parking

 A lot of parking lots and parking garages are automated and work by scanning your car on the way in. For these types of lots, you simply have to pay by card or cash through your window as you're exiting. This is common for public lots.
